title: The Doubled Answer
prompt:
**Scenario.** A counting solution returns exactly twice the expected answer on every non-trivial input. Which catalog category?

**Which approach is the best fit? The program only needs to print the letter.**

**A)** Boundary off-by-one

**B)** Ordered/unordered counting — counted (i,j) and (j,i) as distinct

**C)** State staleness

**D)** Greedy exchange violation

tests.name: answer
tests.hint: Exact-doubling is the ordered-pair signature: x·(x−1) instead of x·(x−1)/2. Off-by-one shifts by one item, not a factor of two.
